articles.title: The Future of Artificial Intelligence Is Already Here
articles.description: Artificial intelligence is rapidly changing the way people work, create, communicate, and solve everyday problems.
articles.dek: AI is no longer just a futuristic idea. It is becoming part of everyday life.
articles.intro: Artificial intelligence has moved from science fiction into everyday life. From smartphones and creative tools to business and education, AI is changing how people interact with technology.

sections.heading: How AI Is Changing Everyday Life
paragraphs: AI tools can now help people write, create images, analyze information, translate languages, and automate repetitive tasks.
As the technology continues to develop, understanding how to use AI responsibly will become increasingly important.

images.alt: Artificial intelligence helping people create and work
images.caption: AI is becoming a powerful tool for creativity, productivity, and everyday work.

articles.closing: The future of technology is being shaped today. AI will continue to evolve, and the people who learn how to use it effectively will be better prepared for what comes next.
